title: Pure Kuriboh
summary: Pure Kuriboh build with the five Kuriboh brothers, Kuribabylon, Five Star Twilight, and generic staples. The deck swarms five Level 1 Fiends at once by Tributing Kuribabylon or using Multiply, while hand-trap Kuribohs stop attacks and negate opposing monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Kuriboh - Multiply! Special Summons itself when the opponent declares an attack or activates a monster effect on the field, pulls a 300 ATK / 200 DEF monster from the Deck or GY, and drops an opposing monster's ATK to 0.

Kuribabylon Special Summons itself from the hand while your GY has more monsters than the opponent's, giving you a lone Level 5 monster for Five Star Twilight or Tributing itself to summon all five Kuriboh brothers from your hand and GY.
The Flute of Summoning Kuriboh adds Kuriboh to your hand or Special Summons it directly from the Deck at Quick-Play speed.
Kuribandit excavates five cards in the End Phase to add a Spell/Trap (Five Star Twilight or Multiply) while stocking the GY with monsters for Kuribabylon and Kuribohrn.

summary.title: Opening: Kuribabylon + Five Star Twilight
steps: Summon Kuribabylon as the only monster you control and activate Five Star Twilight to Tribute it and Special Summon Kuribabylon's five Level 1 brothers—Kuriboh, Kuribah, Kuribee, Kuribeh, and Kuriboo—from your hand, Deck, or GY.
Convert the five Level 1 bodies into Linkuriboh and generic Link Monsters from the Extra Deck, or bounce Kuribabylon itself on a later turn to re-summon the five brothers from your hand and GY.

summary.title: The Five Brothers & Hand-Trap Defense
summary.text: Each of the five brothers adds utility alongside Five Star Twilight: Kuriboo discards on an attack to search a Kuriboh monster, Kuribee negates an attack and searches a Kuriboh Spell/Trap when destroyed, Kuribah summons a 300/200 monster when a Kuriboh is destroyed, and Kuribeh discards to boost a Kuriboh by 1500 ATK. Beyond the brothers, Darkuriboh discards to make a Fiend indestructible and un-negatable, Detonating Kuriboh Special Summons itself next to a Kuriboh and equips to an opposing monster to negate its activated effect, Sphere Kuriboh switches an attacker to Defense Position, and Kuribohrn revives Kuribohs from the GY.

summary.title: Control & Payoff
points: Linkuriboh (Limited) turns any Level 1 Kuriboh into a Link-1 that Tributes itself to reduce an opposing attacker's ATK to 0 and revives itself from the GY by Tributing a Level 1 monster.
Multiply Tributes a face-up Kuriboh to fill all available Main Monster Zones with Level 1 Kuriboh Tokens for Link climbing or chump-blocking.
Relinkuriboh draws a card whenever it is Tributed (including for Linkuriboh's GY revival) and banishes itself from the GY to protect a monster from battle destruction.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Dark Magician and Fusion hybrid engines are omitted in this pure build. Winged Kuriboh Sabatiel LV10 is also left out because its search is built around Polymerization/Fusion Spells and locks your Extra Deck to HERO monsters.
